title: 第118章 这才乖嘛第117章 跟我回去
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
长公主站在门外，看着那扇已经关紧的门板，沉默了一瞬，然后她用力跺了一下脚，靴底在石板路上发出一声闷响，像是要把自己被推出来的那股气力全部通过那一下踩碎在脚底。
她攥着袖口的布料，咬牙切齿地从嗓子里挤出一句：“白婉婉那个骗子——她明明说元梵在这里过得非常辛苦，吃不好睡不好，整天被人压榨——“
院门里面的烛火透过门缝的细隙漏出来，在她脚前的石板上铺开一道极细的光线。
长公主又看了一眼那扇门板，咬了一下嘴唇，最终还是没有再去推它，转身沿着来时的山路走了回去，脚步比来时沉了不少，像是每一步都较着劲。
江欲把元梵放在床榻上的时候，他的后背落进被褥里发出一声极轻的闷响。
他的手指还搭在她的肩膀上没有松开，像是在方才那段被抱进来的路上始终维持着这个姿势，到了床榻上之后依然没有第一时间收回去。
江欲站直身子的同时他也收回了手，指尖沿着她肩头的布料滑落下来落在自己膝侧的被面上，像是在找一个合适的位置安放。
江欲在他面前站定了低头看着他，烛火从她身后照过来，把她身形的影子投在床榻内侧的墙壁上，元梵正坐在那片影子里，银白色的长发散落在肩头和枕边，他的耳根还带着一层方才被她抱起来时泛上去的绯色，还没有完全褪干净。
他微微偏着头，像是在避开那道光直接落在自己脸上，手指搭在被面边缘轻轻攥了一下又松开。
江欲突然开口问道：“以前在皇宫的时候，你过的是什么样的日子？“
元梵的睫毛动了一下，他没有立刻回答，垂下眼看着自己搭在被面上的手指，过了一小会儿才开口，声音淡淡的，像是在说一件已经过去很久的事情。
“挺好的。吃穿不愁，观星台最高处能看到整个皇城的灯火。“
江欲站在床沿边上看着他，看着他说话时垂着眼睛的模样，，然后她弯下腰，伸手按在了他搭在膝侧的手背上。
她的手掌盖着他的手背，力道不重，可那个接触像是在他正要往下落的话语上轻轻接了一下。
“你骗不了我，说实话。“
元梵的手指在她掌心里微微蜷了一下。他抬起眼来看她，目光在她脸上停了一瞬，像是想要从她的表情里找到一丝“她只是在猜“的痕迹，可他什么都没有找到。
他的睫毛颤了两下，然后他偏过头去，目光落在自己被她按着的手背边缘，过了好一会儿才开口。
他的声音比方才低了一些：“皇帝要我无时无刻都在观星台上待命，只要有战事或者天灾就要立刻推演星象。有时候连着两三天不让我下来，身边只放一壶冷茶和几块干粮。长公主——”
他停了一下，像是在那个名字上犹豫了一瞬，然后接着说：“她对我很好，可她的好让我喘不过气来，我说过很多次我不喜欢她，她听不进去，她每个月都要来观星台看我，我跟她说过了很多次，她当没听见。“
他的声音说到最后的时候又低了一些，江欲按在他手背上的手指微微收拢了一下，她低头看着他偏过去的侧脸和银白色的发尾，开口的时候声音比方才轻了一点。

“所以你不愿意跟她回去。“
元梵没有说话，可他也没有摇头。
他只是继续偏着头，看着床榻内侧那道被烛火映在墙上的影子，过了好一会儿才动了动嘴唇，声音像是从一层薄薄的隔膜后面透过来的：“……嗯。“
元梵沉默了一会儿，他的目光还落在床榻内侧那道被烛火映在墙上的影子上，银白色的长发散落在枕边，在烛火中泛着一层温润的光。
“你是不是要把我送回去？“
他的尾音落得很轻，像是一句他已经做好了接受答案的准备的话。
他依然偏着头没有看江欲，他的手指搭在被面边缘微微收紧了一下又松开，像是在等着那道他会以为会落下来的回答。
江欲还弯着腰，手掌盖在他的手背上没有收回去。
她看着他偏过去的侧脸，看着他微微抿着的嘴唇和垂下来的睫毛：“你是在问我，是不是要问我想不想让你留下？“
元梵的睫毛动了一下，他慢慢地把目光从墙壁上的影子上移回来，落在江欲脸上，像是想要从她的话语里找到一层他没有预料到的出口。
他的嘴唇动了一下，没有发出声音，但也没有移开目光。
他的耳根又开始泛起一层极浅的粉，像是有什么东西正在他的皮肤底下缓慢地浮上来，他自己也控制不住它的速度。
江欲看着他，然后抬手托住了他的下颌，把他的脸往自己的方向微微转了一下。
她的力道不重，只是让他的目光正正地和她对上，没有给他再偏回去的余地。
她看着他，开口的时候声音比方才慢了一些，像是在每一个字之间都留出了一点让他能够接住的空间：“我想听实话。“
元梵的手指在被面上攥了一下又松开了，他看着江欲的眼睛，看着她那双正看着他、正在等他说出那两个字的光，他的嘴唇抿了一下又松开。
过了很久，他点了点头，点完之后他的目光没有移开，像是已经把那两个字交出去了。
江欲的嘴角在那一下点头之后缓慢地弯了起来。
她低头在他脸上亲了一口，嘴唇落在他的脸颊靠近嘴角的位置，停了一下才收回来。
她的声音在他耳边响起来，带着一种她方才没有露出来的确实很满意的笑意：“这才对嘛，我一定不会让她带走你的。“

系统在江欲脑海里响了一声，声音带着一种像是“我就知道会这样“的轻快。
【叮——元梵好感度5，当前好感度10。】
【不过宿主你要小心一点哦，这个长公主可不会这么轻易的就把它放弃了的。】

content_en:
The eldest princess stood outside the door, looking at the closed door. She was silent for a moment, then she stamped her foot hard, and the soles of her boots made a muffled sound on the stone road, as if all the force of being pushed out was crushed under her feet.
She gripped the fabric of her cuffs and gritted her teeth and squeezed out a sentence from her throat: "That liar Bai Wanwan - she clearly said that Yuan Fan lived a very hard life here. He couldn't eat well or sleep well, and was exploited all day long - "
The candlelight inside the courtyard door leaked through the small cracks in the door, spreading a very thin light on the stone slab in front of her feet.
The eldest princess glanced at the door panel again, bit her lip, and finally did not push it anymore. She turned around and walked back along the mountain road she came from. Her footsteps were much heavier than when she came, as if every step was strenuous.
When Jiang Yu put Yuan Fan on the bed, his back fell into the quilt and made a very light muffled sound.
His fingers were still on her shoulders, as if he had maintained this position on the way to being brought in, and he still didn't take them away immediately after arriving on the bed.
When Jiang wanted to stand up straight, he also retracted his hand. His fingertips slid along the fabric on her shoulders and landed on the quilt beside his knees, as if he was looking for a suitable place to place it.
Jiang Yu stood still in front of him and looked down at him. The candlelight shone from behind her, casting the shadow of her figure on the wall inside the bed. Yuan Fan was sitting in the shadow, with his long silver-white hair scattered on his shoulders and pillow. His ears still had a layer of crimson that had appeared when he was picked up by her, which had not completely faded away.
He tilted his head slightly, as if to avoid the light falling directly on his face. He put his fingers on the edge of the quilt and lightly clenched it and then released it.
Jiang Yu suddenly asked: "What kind of life did you live when you were in the palace?"
Yuan Fan's eyelashes fluttered, but he didn't answer immediately. He lowered his eyes and looked at his fingers on the quilt. He spoke after a short while, his voice was light, as if he was talking about something that had passed a long time ago.
"It's pretty good. You don't have to worry about food and clothing. You can see the lights of the entire imperial city from the highest point of the observatory."
Jiang Yu stood on the edge of the bed and looked at him, watching the way he lowered his eyes when he spoke. Then she bent down and put her hand on the back of his hand that was resting on his knee.
Her palm covered the back of his hand, and the force was not heavy, but the contact seemed to lightly catch the words he was about to say.
"You can't lie to me, tell the truth."
Yuan Fan's fingers curled slightly in her palm. He raised his eyes to look at her, and his eyes paused on her face for a moment, as if he wanted to find a trace of "she was just guessing" in her expression, but he found nothing.
His eyelashes trembled twice, then he turned his head, his eyes fell on the edge of the back of his hand that was held by her, and he spoke after a while.
His voice was a little lower than before: "The emperor wants me to be on standby at the observatory all the time. As long as there is a war or natural disaster, I must deduce the stars immediately. Sometimes I will not be allowed to come down for two or three days in a row. I will only have a pot of cold tea and a few pieces of dry food next to me. The eldest princess——"
He paused, as if hesitating on the name for a moment, and then continued: "She is very good to me, but her kindness makes me breathless. I have said many times that I don't like her, but she can't listen. She comes to the observatory to see me every month. I have told her many times, but she pretends not to hear."
His voice dropped a little lower at the end. Jiang Yu's fingers on the back of his hand tightened slightly. She looked down at his side face and the tail of his silver-white hair, and her voice was a little softer than before when she spoke.
"So you don't want to go back with her."
Yuan Fan didn't speak, but he didn't shake his head either.
He just continued to tilt his head, looking at the shadow on the wall reflected by the candlelight on the inside of the bed.After a while, he moved his lips, and his voice seemed to come from behind a thin diaphragm: "...Hmm."
Yuan Fan was silent for a while, his eyes still falling on the shadow on the wall reflected by the candlelight on the inside of the bed. His long silver-white hair was scattered on the pillow, glowing with a warm light in the candlelight.
"Are you going to send me back?"
His final voice fell softly, as if he was ready for the answer.
He still tilted his head and didn't look at Jiang Yu. His fingers rested on the edge of the quilt, tightening slightly and then loosening, as if waiting for the answer he thought would come.
Jiang Yu was still bent over, his palm covering the back of his hand without taking it back.
She looked at his side face, his slightly pursed lips and drooped eyelashes: "Are you asking me if I want you to stay?"
Yuan Fan's eyelashes fluttered, and he slowly moved his gaze back from the shadow on the wall and landed on Jiang Yu's face, as if he wanted to find an outlet in her words that he had not expected.
His lips moved but he didn't make a sound, but he didn't look away either.
A very light layer of pink began to appear at the base of his ears again, as if something was slowly rising under his skin, and he couldn't control its speed.
Jiang Yu looked at him, then raised his hand to hold his chin, and turned his face slightly towards her.
Her strength was not heavy, it just made his eyes meet hers squarely, leaving no room for him to turn back.
She looked at him, and when she spoke, her voice was slower than before, as if leaving a little space between each word for him to catch it: "I want to hear the truth."
Yuan Fan's fingers clenched and unclenched on the quilt. He looked at Jiang Yu's eyes and her eyes that were looking at him, waiting for him to say those two words. His lips pursed and then unclenched.
After a long time, he nodded. After nodding, he did not look away, as if he had handed over those two words.
The corners of Jiang Yu's mouth slowly curved up after that nod.
She lowered her head and kissed him on the face. Her lips landed on his cheek near the corner of his mouth, and she paused for a moment before pulling back.
Her voice rang in his ears, with a satisfied smile that she had not shown just now: "This is right, I will definitely not let her take you away."
The system rang in Jiang Yu's mind, and the voice sounded brisk like "I knew it would be like this."
[Ding——Yuanfan’s favorability is 5, and his current favorability is 10. 】
[But host, you have to be careful, this eldest princess will not give it up so easily. 】
